name: Timeline
what: The place Timeline shows one line of time for each computer, with its checkpoints, turns, commands, asks, alerts and recordings. A routine stretch collapses into one line with counts, decided from facts and reports only, and the line says when a classifier calls part of it thrashing. From a moment on the line you fork, or restore the computer to it.

suggest.why: Going back is useful only once you can find the moment, and alerts open there.
